title: LibraryCatalogInvalidationResult
description:
Counts owned by the gateway issuer of a library catalog invalidation (MCPG-1833).
Issuer-owned configuration and command counts are not cross-store completion.
The pending/retry report pointer for the platform-side outcome arrives with the
platform consumer slice of OpenSpec task 3.2.

configurationsAddressed.description: Gets the number of gateway configurations whose stored snapshot was cleared.

commandsIssued.description:
Gets the number of durable commands published. A tenant with more than
one source coordinate can contribute more than one command; holder tenant
ids stay the distinct set.

holderTenantIds.description: Gets the holder tenants a command was issued for.

holderTenantsAttempted.description:
Gets the holder tenants this pass tried to invalidate (fence exceeded).
A tenant already at the command generation is not attempted.

holderTenantsSkippedDuplicateKey.description:
Gets tenants skipped because SaveChanges hit the fence primary-key
conflict. Other tenants in the same pass still commit.

holderTenantsSkippedConcurrency.description:
Gets tenants skipped after a concurrency retry could not prove the
clears and fence landed. Other tenants in the same pass still commit.

holdersSkippedUnbound.description:
Gets configuration ids whose unbound observation was unusable: it failed,
produced a blank coordinate, or the refresh succeeded without establishing
freshness, with no recorded stamp to fall back to. This is not a veto of another
command. An unversioned copy on such a row may still be cleared by another
command for the library and counted in int LibraryCatalogInvalidationResult.ConfigurationsAddressed.

holdersSkippedObservationFailed.description:
Gets configuration ids that were observed at request time and failed,
produced a blank coordinate, or whose refresh succeeded without
establishing freshness, with no recorded source coordinate to fall back to.

holdersSkippedClearConflict.description:
Gets configuration ids that were addressed for a snapshot clear that a
concurrency retry could not prove landed. Present only on
string LibraryCatalogInvalidationErrorCodes.CatalogSnapshotClearConflict.
This is not an observation failure and is never merged into
IReadOnlyList<Guid> LibraryCatalogInvalidationResult.HoldersSkippedObservationFailed.

holdersNotAttempted.description:
Gets configuration ids whose holder binding was not observed because the
per-request binding cap or observation deadline was hit. Empty on a
complete pass. This is not an observation failure.

holdersCoveredByCoordinate.description:
Gets configuration ids of blank Cleared holders covered by one observation
of an unfenced recorded coordinate for the same tenant. Not skipped and
not unattempted. The command identity is (tenant, library, coordinate,
generation).

oneOf.description:
Gets why a pass stopped early:
LibraryCatalogInvalidationIncompleteReason.ObservationCap,
LibraryCatalogInvalidationIncompleteReason.ObservationDeadline,
or LibraryCatalogInvalidationIncompleteReason.CascadeDeadline.
Null when every holder binding was observed or covered by a selected
coordinate, and a cascade either finished or was not run.

reason.description:
Gets the typed refusal when the issuer did not issue a command, or
`null` on success.
